qualification.education_qualification: Post graduate degree in women/gender studies or related social sciences, 10-15 years experience in Gender related programmes with 7 years at policy level monitoring PC&PNDT Act, Technical knowledge and field experience of gender issues in NHM programmes particularly PNDT and sex selection/FP/RH/MNH
qualification.details: Lead Consultant - : Post graduate degree in women/gender studies or related social sciences with good technical knowledge of gender issues. 10-15 years of experience in implementing Gender related programmes out of which 7 years’ experience at the policy level in monitoring the implementation of PC&PNDT Act on a senior position at the national level.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHSRC Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NHSRC Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT posts is 25th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in women/gender studies or related social sciences, along with significant experience in gender-related programs and policy-level monitoring of the PC&PNDT Act.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT position is 55 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 1,30,000/- to Rs. 1,70,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the position of Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of NHSRC.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NHSRC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the provided recruitment details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Lead Consultant – Gender and PNDT position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this role will primarily involve a Written Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the type of job offered by NHSRC?
faq.answer: The job offered by NHSRC for this position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website is also provided.
